'''Daltist Se'gen''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] rancher and resident of [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. During the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian uprising]], he was attacked by [[Hidden Chain]] poachers who were rustling his [[gapillian grazer]]s. Unable to do anything about the poachers himself, he asked an individual to recover the grazers that had been stolen, which they did.<ref name="TOR:GG"/>

==Behind the scenes==
*The quest that Daltist Se'gen gives is only available to Republic players.<ref name="TOR:GG"/>
